name: Mehit of Eshkalon
source:
Mehit of Eshkalon is the mother of Lilith of Eshkalon. She is generally supportive of her daughter's talents, but is often embarrassed by what she perceives to be Lilith's rudeness. She is the only non-arcanist present at the Conclave of the Universal Panacea.

[From [url=https://everblossom.miraheze.org/wiki/Mehit_of_Eshkalon]The Flower That Bloomed Nowhere Wiki[/url]]
